air_absorption.comparison: same 100 m geometry and source gain; vary only air_absorption.enabled

properties: Approach samples are finite and their calibrated direct PCM level is monotonic nondecreasing until the safety ceiling.
The 100 m to 1 m direct-level change is spreading-dominated and approximately 40 dB before any safety stage.
Brightness changes continuously across adjacent approach samples.
At the same 100 m distance, enabled air absorption has no greater high-band energy than disabled air absorption; this comparison is independent of level ordering.
non_claims: This fixture does not establish headphone-ear SPL without output calibration.
This fixture does not establish audible quality or pathing.
